group.title: Meeting-room booking rules
group.passage:
Meeting-room booking update

Room bookings will be released if the organizer has not checked in within fifteen minutes of the reserved start time. Check-in can be completed on the panel outside the room or through the booking app.

Meetings with external visitors should include the visitor count in the reservation. Reception uses this information to prepare temporary badges. Do not enter visitors’ personal identity numbers in the booking notes.

If your meeting ends early, release the room in the app so that others can use it. Moving chairs does not cancel a reservation. Rooms with video-conferencing equipment are marked with a camera icon; an ordinary screen alone does not indicate that a camera is installed.
group.passageZh:
會議室預約更新

若主辦人在預約開始後十五分鐘內未報到，預約將被釋出。可在門外面板或預約應用程式中報到。

有外部訪客的會議，請在預約中填訪客人數，櫃檯據此準備臨時識別證。請勿在預約備註中填寫訪客的個人身分識別號碼。

若會議提早結束，請在應用程式釋出會議室，供他人使用。移動椅子不會取消預約。配備視訊會議設備的房間會標攝影機圖示；只有一般螢幕不代表已裝攝影機。
